ContractualAmount.description: One side of the covenant ratio, as the loan agreement defines it.

amount.description:
The amount under that definition for the period ending on the test date, in currency
units.

definition.description:
The definition in the words of the loan agreement, for example "consolidated EBITDA
for the 12 months ending on the test date"; not blank. Echoed in the audit trail.

Covenant.description: One covenant of the loan agreement at one test date.

denominator.description:
Denominator of the covenant ratio, as defined by the loan agreement. Zero or negative:
the outcome is `if_denominator_not_positive`.

if_denominator_not_positive.description:
Outcome when the denominator is zero or negative, as the loan agreement states:
`breached`, `passed` or `not_tested`. Required, no default.

name.description: Name of the covenant as in the loan agreement, for example "net leverage"; not blank.

numerator.description: Numerator of the covenant ratio, as defined by the loan agreement.

operator.description:
Comparison with the threshold: `at_most` (≤), `less_than` (<), `at_least` (≥) or
`greater_than` (>). Required, no default.

rounding.description:
Rounding of the tested value before the comparison, as the loan agreement states.
Absent: no rounding; the outcome is decided on the exact value.

test_date.description: Test date (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). The amounts refer to the period ending on this date.

threshold.description:
Threshold in the unit of numerator / denominator: a multiple (3.5 = 3.5x) or a decimal
fraction (0.30 = 30%), as the loan agreement states it.

Date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 to 2199-12-31.

IfDenominatorNotPositive.description:
The outcome the loan agreement assigns to a covenant whose denominator is zero or negative.
Required, no default.

oneOf.description: The covenant is not tested (never a breach); code `denominator_not_positive`.

Operator.description: How the tested value is compared with the threshold. Required, no default.

oneOf.description: Maximum, inclusive: passes when tested value ≤ threshold.
Maximum, strict: passes when tested value < threshold.
Minimum, inclusive: passes when tested value ≥ threshold.
Minimum, strict: passes when tested value > threshold.

Rounding.description: The rounding of the tested value that the loan agreement states.

decimal_places.description: Decimal places of the rounded tested value, 0 to 6 (2 rounds 3.504 to 3.50).

mode.description: `half_up` (halves away from zero) or `half_even` (halves to the even digit).

oneOf.description: A half is rounded away from zero (3.505 → 3.51, −3.505 → −3.51).
A half is rounded to the even last digit (3.505 → 3.50, 3.515 → 3.52).

covenants.description:
The covenants to test, at least one. Each is tested on its own; the results keep this
order.
